TUNES

The lights go down. The record drops. One voice carries the whole room. Name the song, finish the lyric, call the artist — solo on the big stage or battling with your crew, up to four players deep. This ain't trivia night. This is a concert, and you're the headliner.

The built-in crate just got re-stacked — 55 records of Christian hip-hop, R&B and gospel pulled straight from Tru's playlist. Or bring your own soundtrack: load songs from your device into Your Crate below and the game plays your actual records during rounds. Every built-in song also links out to YouTube, Spotify and Apple Music.

How to run the show

Three steps to the spotlight

01

Set the stage

Pick your players — fly solo or bring up to four contenders. Choose a challenge mode and a set list: Gospel Now, Kingdom Hip-Hop, Soul & R&B Praise, Worship Heat — or load Your Crate and run the show on your own records.

02

Work the mic

Every round, the music actually plays — your uploaded records spin for real, and the built-in sets ride a live stage groove while the vinyl turns. You've got 30 seconds on the clock. Tap your answer, type it, or hit Say It and call it out loud. Stuck? Spend points on a Selah Whisper hint or a 50/50 — or pass the mic and let the next player try to steal your shine.

03

Take the crown

Correct answers stack points, streaks stack bonuses. Race to 1,000 points, race to 2,000, or go Endless and let the records keep spinning all night. Every new song carries a fresh word from The Message at the bottom of the stage.

Sound check

Set the stage

Build your show exactly how you want it. DJ Selah — your host for the night — will keep the energy up, drop the hints, and call every play like it's the finals.

Who's performing?

Solo is you against the catalog. Battle is pass-and-play — up to four players, one stage, winner takes the crown.

Pick your challenge

Four ways to prove you know the music. Lightning Mix shuffles all of them, every single round.

Choose your set list

Contemporary, youthful, all TRU energy — no dusty hymnals. Or skip our taste entirely and run Your Crate: the songs you load in the next section.

How long's the show?

Race modes end the moment somebody crosses the line. Endless keeps the records spinning until you call it.

Tap Test Sound first — hear the chime and the stage is live. Sound on for the full show.
Your music, your stage

Bring your own soundtrack

Our catalog not your vibe? Load the records YOU love — your playlist, your choir's new single, the songs on repeat in your car. Pick Your Crate as the set list and the game plays your actual audio during every round: name it, name the artist, finish the lyric. Your files stay on this device for this visit only — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
